newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet activity.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed on Monday in subdued dealings due to the observance of the Columbus Day holiday, dealers said.
Dealers said they were also watching the direction of CBOT corn and soymeal prices which slumped last Friday.
"We have not sold anything today (Monday)," a Minneapolis dealer said. "We want to wait-and-see where (CBOT) corn settles." But he noted strong demand for spot mids.
In the St Louis area, demand for spot mids was also better, another dealer said.
A Tennessee broker said even though CBOT soymeal was lower, it was still too expensive. "You can't buy meal cheap enough," he said.
One Buffalo dealer added "it was difficult to get anything along the lines of an offer. We will have a better idea tomorrow (Tuesday)."
